Jio Platforms and Airtel Money Pursue Major Listings

Jio Platforms is reportedly being considered for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) at a valuation of approximately ₹11 lakh crore, which would place it slightly above Airtel's current market capitalization of around ₹10.87 lakh crore. Concurrently, Airtel Money has made its debut on the London Stock Exchange with a valuation of $7 billion.
